> Release app runner on Linux: the executable of packaged nsh apps (no development features). Version 0.6.0, targets and dependencies.

## Workspace dependencies

[`nsh-base`](/crates/nsh-base/), [`nsh-engine`](/crates/nsh-engine/), [`nsh-platform-linux`](/crates/nsh-platform-linux/). It also uses 2 crates from outside the workspace.

## Features

`crypto`, `default`, `editor`, `emoji-picker`, `highlight`, `js`, `math`, `net`, `plot`, `rich-editor`, `shader`, `sound`, `svg`, `term`, `updater`, `websocket`, `webview`, `zlib`

## Build

Run this from the repository root.

```bash
cargo build --release -p nsh-linux-app
```
